headline: Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Muhammad Junaid Anwar Chaudhry on Thursday proposed that seafood exporters allocate at least 5% of their total exports to value-added products, noting that only three of 578 seafood exporters currently deal in such products, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Only 3 of 578 seafood exporters sell value-added products

caption:
Only 3 of Pakistan's 578 seafood exporters sell value-added products! 🦐
According to Business Recorder, Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Muhammad Junaid Anwar Chaudhry has proposed that seafood exporters allocate at least 5% of their total exports to value-added products such as processed and packaged seafood. He set up a committee, headed by Fisheries Development Commissioner Dr Muhammad Hafeez-ur-Rehman, to work with provincial fisheries departments and exporters on ways to promote processed seafood and raise foreign exchange earnings. He also urged investment in processing, packaging, aquaculture and shrimp hatcheries.
